Restaurant.title: Restaurant
Restaurant.description: Central shared restaurant entity containing settings, categories, menu items, modifier groups, and store availability

settings.description: Store settings, logo, name, phone, hours, holidays, notificationSound

categories.description: List of categories with sortOrder, name EN/TH

menuItems.description: List of menu items with name EN/TH, description, price, modifiers, imageUrl, availability

modifierGroups.description: List of modifier groups and options with price and availability

customer.description: Customer name, phone, delivery address, notes

items.description: Immutable snapshot of ordered items with modifiers and prices

acceptedAt.description: ISO timestamp when restaurant accepted order

onTheWayAt.description: ISO timestamp when order left for delivery

completedAt.description: ISO timestamp when order was delivered/picked up

/restaurants/{restaurantId}.description: Master restaurant document accessed across customer and owner devices

/orders/{orderId}.description: Customer order document synchronized in real-time

/counters/{counterId}.description: Atomic counters for sequential order numbers
